name: Bog Hound

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The bog hound makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Opportunist's Lash.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

Actions.name: Opportunist's Lash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 30 feet that is Grappled by the bog hound. *Failure:* 9 (2d8) Piercing damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Whelm
Bonus Actions.text: The bog hound whelms one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While whelmed, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the bog hound, and takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the bog hound's turns. The bog hound can have only one creature whelmed at a time. If the bog hound takes 5 damage or more in a single turn from the whelmed creature, the bog hound must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits Prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the bog hound. If the bog hound dies, a whelmed creature pulls free Prone by using 5 feet of movement.

Traits.name: Muck-Slick Hide
Traits.text: While the bog hound has the Grappled or Restrained condition, at the start of its turn, the bog hound ends the Grappled or Restrained condition on itself.

lore: A drowned fishing dog that rose from the silt where fishermen's bodies settle, it now hunts the shallows for the living to drag down beside the dead.

generation.userConcept: a mud-caked bog hound that drags fishermen under
generation.cite: composition after Giant Crocodile (CR 5) jaws + Giant Toad (CR 1) swallow — print swallows at LOW CR
